# good-skill

[![test](https://github.com/example-org/good-skill/actions/workflows/test.yml/badge.svg)](https://github.com/example-org/good-skill/actions/workflows/test.yml) [![License: MIT](https://img.shields.io/badge/license-MIT-blue.svg)](LICENSE)

![A greeting file opened in an editor](docs/demo.svg)

A tiny example skill that writes a greeting file. It exists to show what a well-kept skill repository looks like.

## Install

```bash
git clone https://github.com/example-org/good-skill ~/.claude/skills/good-skill
```

## Quick start

```bash
node scripts/hello.mjs out/hello.txt Ada
```

See [references/usage.md](references/usage.md) for every option.
